tools.name: get_venues
tools.description: Retrieves all published venues for the brand. Call this first to get venueId values required by all other tools.

venueTeaser.description: Short promotional teaser for the venue

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the venue (e.g. Asia/Kolkata). Use for local date/time context.

localDateTime.description: Current date and time at the venue, in the venue's local timezone

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for this snapshot

tools.name: get_available_games
tools.description: Get games configured at a venue for the current day (schedule, pricing, categories). Returns one row per physical room (gameId). gameName is the customer-facing theme name — multiple rows may share the same gameName (same experience, different rooms). Does not indicate seat availability for a date — use search_available_seats before offering times or saying a game can be booked on a date. Use categoryId values from peopleCategories when building slot people arrays.

gameId.description: Physical game/room ID. Required in slot inputs. Several gameIds may share one gameName (same customer-facing experience, different rooms).

gameName.description: Customer-facing theme name (e.g. Murder Mystery, Classified). Multiple gameIds may share the same gameName — same experience, different rooms. Book with gameId + eventId from search_available_seats.

gameTeaser.description: Short promotional teaser for the game

peopleCategories.description: Available people categories (use categoryId when creating slots)

categoryId.description: Category ID to use in slot people array

min.description: Minimum number of people allowed in this category per slot

max.description: Maximum number of people allowed in this category per slot

sharedEnabled.description: Whether open/shared booking is available (other groups may share the slot)

tools.name: search_available_seats
tools.description: Search time slot availability for one or more games over a date range (max 7 days). gameName is the customer-facing theme name (multiple gameIds may share it). Omit gameId/gameIds to search all rooms at the venue, or pass every gameId that shares a gameName when checking one experience. Results are sorted by date then time (multi-room slots for the same experience interleave, e.g. 7:00 and 7:10). Each slot includes isPast and isAvailable. Only offer slots where isAvailable=true (and isPast=false). If slots exist but all are isPast, say nothing is left that day and suggest another date. Use the returned date, time, gameId, and eventId directly in slot inputs.

gameId.description: Optional: filter to one physical room. Omit (with gameIds) to search all rooms, or pass all gameIds for one gameName.

gameIds.description: Optional: comma-separated physical room IDs. Omit both gameId and gameIds to search every room at the venue.

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to startDate)

gameId.description: Physical game/room ID. Required in slot inputs. Several gameIds may share one gameName (same customer-facing experience, different rooms).

gameName.description: Customer-facing theme name (e.g. Murder Mystery, Classified). Multiple gameIds may share the same gameName — same experience, different rooms. Book with gameId + eventId from search_available_seats.

eventId.description: Unique identifier for the specific event slot

held.description: Number of seats currently held (temporary reservations)

available.description: Number of seats available for booking

isAvailable.description: Whether this slot can be booked (available seats > 0 and not in past)

isPast.description: Whether this slot start time has already passed in the venue timezone

isPrivate.description: Whether this event is already privately reserved and unavailable for new bookings

tools.name: search_customers
tools.description: Search customers by partial name/email match. Use returned customerId in create_booking. Always provide firstName, lastName, and email or phone in create_booking regardless of customerId.

customerId.description: Customer ID to use in create_booking

tools.name: create_instant_cart
tools.description: Create a temporary instant cart to reserve one or more time slots (multi-room: multiple slots in one call, same date). Returns cartId to use in subsequent calls. Seats may be held automatically depending on venue settings (check isHold and expiresAt). Each slot needs gameId, date, and time copied from a matching search_available_seats row — invented times are rejected.

slots.description: Slots to reserve on one date. Multi-room bookings: one slot per physical room (each with its own gameId, time, and people split). Copy gameId and time from search_available_seats — do not reuse one gameId for different room times.

gameId.description: Physical room ID from the search_available_seats row for this slot's time

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. All slots must use the same date.

people.description: People per category. Use categoryId from get_available_games.

number.description: Number of people in this category

isPrivate.description: Whether to book as a private session. Only valid when privateEnabled=true on the game. Required for private-only games.

cartId.description: Cart ID to use in subsequent calls

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when held seats will be released if booking is not completed

people.description: Array of people categories and counts

categoryName.description: Human-readable name of the people category

number.description: Number of people for this category

isPrivate.description: Whether this is a private slot

tools.name: get_instant_cart
tools.description: Retrieve the current state of an instant cart. Use this as a recovery tool when a create_booking call times out — inspect the cart status to determine whether to retry or proceed.

cartId.description: Cart ID to use in subsequent calls

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when held seats will be released if booking is not completed

people.description: Array of people categories and counts

categoryName.description: Human-readable name of the people category

number.description: Number of people for this category

isPrivate.description: Whether this is a private slot

tools.name: update_instant_cart
tools.description: Update an existing instant cart by replacing all slots with new ones

slots.description: Full replacement slot list. All existing slots are replaced. Use the same structure as create_instant_cart.

number.description: Number of people in this category

isPrivate.description: Whether to book as a private session. Only valid when privateEnabled=true on the game.

cartId.description: Cart ID to use in subsequent calls

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when held seats will be released if booking is not completed

people.description: Array of people categories and counts

categoryName.description: Human-readable name of the people category

number.description: Number of people for this category

isPrivate.description: Whether this is a private slot

tools.name: release_instant_cart
tools.description: Release an instant cart, freeing up any held seats for other users. Use this to abandon a booking in progress before confirmation. For canceling a confirmed booking, use cancel_booking instead.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Convert an instant cart into a confirmed booking. Handles hold and checkout automatically. The customer will be notified by email. Always provide idempotencyKey to ensure retry safety.

cartId.description: The instant cart ID to convert

slots.description: Slot data used to recalculate pricing and verify availability at booking time. Must exactly match the slots in the instant cart.

people.description: People per category. Use categoryId from get_available_games peopleCategories.

number.description: Number of people for this category

isPrivate.description: Whether to book as a private session

customer.description: Customer information. Always include firstName, lastName, and either email or phone. Add customerId for existing customers.

phone.description: Customer phone in international format (e.g. +12345678989). Required if no email.

sendPaymentRequest.description: Send customer a payment link email/SMS to complete booking payment. Defaults to true; set false only for pay-in-person bookings with no online payment link.

idempotencyKey.description: Strongly recommended. Unique key (e.g. UUID) to prevent duplicate bookings if the call is retried. Same key + same payload returns the stored response. Same key + different payload returns 409.

status.description: Booking status after creation: CONFIRMED when fully paid; RESERVED when payment is still outstanding.

orderUrl.description: Full URL to the customer's order page showing the completed booking details, terms and conditions, cancellation and rescheduling policies. Share this with the customer to view their order.

paymentUrl.description: Order URL with Pay button enabled. Present when payment is still due (status RESERVED).

people.description: Array of people categories and counts

categoryName.description: Human-readable name of the people category

number.description: Number of people for this category

message.description: Success message with booking details, payment request information, and customer notification channels used

emailNotificationSent.description: True if an email notification was sent successfully

whatsappNotificationSent.description: True if a WhatsApp notification was sent successfully

paymentDeadline.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which the booking is auto-cancelled if unpaid. Null when fully paid, pay-at-venue, or no deadline configured. Human-readable deadline text is included in message.

tools.name: get_venue_policy
tools.description: Return the human-readable policy texts for a venue — terms & conditions, cancellation policy, and reschedule policy. Use this to answer customer questions about venue policies. Do NOT use it to determine whether a specific booking operation is allowed — use get_booking_edit_options for that.

termsConditions.description: Terms and conditions text. Null when not configured.

cancellationPolicy.description: Cancellation policy description including fee rules. Null when not configured.

reschedulePolicy.description: Reschedule policy description including fee rules. Null when not configured.

tools.name: find_booking
tools.description: Look up a confirmed booking by its orderId. Required as prerequisite for cancel_booking and reschedule_booking — call this first to get bookingId and slot eventIds.

orderIdentifier.description: Order identifier in any format: #dhn3tl, dhn3tl, or or_dHN3TL

orderUrl.description: Full URL to the customer order page

slots.description: Array of booking slots with games and times

eventId.description: Event ID — use as slotEventId in cancel/reschedule operations

gameId.description: Physical game/room ID. Required in slot inputs. Several gameIds may share one gameName (same customer-facing experience, different rooms).

gameName.description: Customer-facing theme name (e.g. Murder Mystery, Classified). Multiple gameIds may share the same gameName — same experience, different rooms. Book with gameId + eventId from search_available_seats.

people.description: People categories and counts for this slot

number.description: Number of people in this category

isPrivate.description: Whether this is a private slot

isCanceled.description: Whether this slot has been canceled

tools.name: get_booking_edit_options
tools.description: Get complete cancellation and rescheduling options, fees, and policy validation for all slots in a booking. Call this after find_booking and before cancel_booking or reschedule_booking to inform the customer of applicable fees.

cancellationOptions.description: Cancellation options and fees for all slots

allowed.description: Whether cancellation is allowed for the booking

eventId.description: The event ID for this slot

gameId.description: Physical game/room ID. Required in slot inputs. Several gameIds may share one gameName (same customer-facing experience, different rooms).

gameName.description: Customer-facing theme name (e.g. Murder Mystery, Classified). Multiple gameIds may share the same gameName — same experience, different rooms. Book with gameId + eventId from search_available_seats.

allowed.description: Whether this slot can be canceled

totals.description: Original booking totals for this slot

totalFee.description: Total cancellation fee for all selected slots

rescheduleOptions.description: Rescheduling options and fees for all slots

eventId.description: The event ID for this slot

gameId.description: Physical game/room ID. Required in slot inputs. Several gameIds may share one gameName (same customer-facing experience, different rooms).

gameName.description: Customer-facing theme name (e.g. Murder Mystery, Classified). Multiple gameIds may share the same gameName — same experience, different rooms. Book with gameId + eventId from search_available_seats.

allowed.description: Whether rescheduling is allowed for this slot under policy

allowReduce.description: Whether reducing people count is allowed

rescheduleFee.description: Rescheduling fee for this slot (null if not allowed)

feeReason.description: Explanation of rescheduling policy or restriction

totalFee.description: Total rescheduling fee for all allowed slots (null if none allowed)

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel one or more slots of a confirmed booking (or the entire booking). Always applies the applicable cancellation fee per venue policy and notifies the customer. Call find_booking first to get bookingId, then get_booking_edit_options to inform the customer of fees.

slotEventIds.description: Specific slot eventIds to cancel (from find_booking slots[].eventId). Omit or pass all slot eventIds to cancel the entire booking.

idempotencyKey.description: Strongly recommended. Unique key (e.g. UUID) to prevent duplicate cancellations if the call is retried. Same key + same payload returns the stored response. Same key + different payload returns 409.

orderUrl.description: Full URL to the customer order page

slots.description: All slots (canceled slots have isCanceled: true)

eventId.description: The event ID for this slot

gameId.description: Physical game/room ID. Required in slot inputs. Several gameIds may share one gameName (same customer-facing experience, different rooms).

gameName.description: Customer-facing theme name (e.g. Murder Mystery, Classified). Multiple gameIds may share the same gameName — same experience, different rooms. Book with gameId + eventId from search_available_seats.

people.description: People categories and counts for this slot

number.description: Number of people in this category

isPrivate.description: Whether this is a private slot

isCanceled.description: Whether this slot has been canceled

totals.description: Updated totals for this slot after cancellation

cancellationFee.description: Cancellation fee for this slot (null if no fee)

refundAmount.description: Refund amount for this slot (null if no refund)

feeApplied.description: Whether cancellation fees were actually applied (true only when fees deducted)

feeAmount.description: Total cancellation fee amount for all canceled slots

refundAmount.description: Total refund amount for all canceled slots

message.description: Success message with cancellation details and fee information

tools.name: reschedule_booking
tools.description: Reschedule one or more slots of a confirmed booking to new dates/times/games. Always applies the applicable rescheduling fee per venue policy and notifies the customer. Call find_booking first, then get_booking_edit_options to check if rescheduling is allowed and inform the customer of fees, then search_available_seats for new slots.

slotEventId.description: The eventId of the slot to reschedule (from find_booking slots[].eventId)

people.description: People configuration (can update counts subject to policy)

idempotencyKey.description: Strongly recommended. Unique key (e.g. UUID) to prevent duplicate reschedulings if the call is retried. Same key + same payload returns the stored response. Same key + different payload returns 409.

orderUrl.description: Full URL to the customer order page

slots.description: Updated slots after rescheduling (includes both unchanged and rescheduled slots)

tools.name: check_payment_status
tools.description: Check the payment status of an order associated with a booking. Returns payment totals, due amount, and whether the order is fully paid.

bookingId.description: The booking ID to check payment status for

status.description: Agent-facing booking payment status: CONFIRMED when fully paid; RESERVED when payment is still outstanding

isPaid.description: True if the order has been fully paid

tools.name: get_faqs
tools.description: Fetch FAQs for a given level and entity. Use level='brand' to get brand-wide FAQs plus all theme FAQs in one call. Use level='venue' to get venue-specific FAQs plus all game FAQs in one call. Use level='theme' or level='game' with entityId for a single entity. Call brand and venue levels at session start and cache the results.

level.description: The FAQ level to retrieve. 'brand' returns brand + all themes. 'venue' returns venue + all games.

entityId.description: Required when level is 'theme' or 'game'. The ID of the specific entity.

entries.description: Array of FAQ entries. For brand/venue levels this includes the parent entity plus all child entities.
